description: This file defines an Android Fragment named LaunchFragment, which handles UI interactions related to building and launching intents within an Android application. It manages lifecycle events, menu options, and communicates with its containing activity through the OnLaunchCallback interface.

classes.name: LaunchFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that facilitates building and launching intents, providing UI and menu options for user interaction, and communicating launch actions to its host activity.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the IntentBuilderView, sets up callback references if the containing activity implements OnLaunchCallback, and enables options menu.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel for the fragment.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Hides the FAB using the ViewModel when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu from XML resource for options menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically launching an intent via the callback if the launch menu item is selected.
